New M6 Mac mini: Amazon now offering first discount on the most affordable model

Heads up folks, Amazon just dropped the price on the base model M6 Mac mini down to $879.99 shipped. That’s not a giant discount or anything but it is less than buying one straight from Apple and the first price drop yet.

Amazon is now offering the base model M6 Mac mini Apple just unveiled down at $879.99 shipped. You’re looking at the most affrodbale 16GB/256GB configuration there.

iPhone 17 Pro just hit its best price ever via Amazon at up to $285 off (Premium Renewed)

Just ahead of the iPhone 18 Pro launch, Amazon is now delivering new all-time lows on iPhone 17 Pro. If you’re looking to side step the full and likely very expensive price on the new Pro models next month, or wait for them to hit the refurbished shelfs for another 6+ months, Amazon’s best quality renewed iPhone 17 Pro units are now $285 off and with a full 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee.

As of right now, the proper Amazon Renewed Premium listings are the very best place to score a deal on iPhone 17 Pro. Apple still does not even carry them in its refurbished store, and we are talking about the best quality units Amazon carries with the full 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life” – these are not your typical refurbished units.

Both the 512GB and 1TB models are now siting at the lowest prices we have ever tracked:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,215 (Reg. $1,499 new) – all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,215 (Reg. $1,499 new) – all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,280 (Reg. $1,499 new) – all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,166 (Reg. $1,299 new) – all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,171 (Reg. $1,299 new) – all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,170 (Reg. $1,299 new) – all-time low

All of the links above will take you to the proper Amazon Renewed Premium listings – watch out for those third-party sellers.

I don’t know about you, but I’m really going to miss the 17 Pro colorways, as much as I did want to see an all black model, and I might very be holding on to mine for another year.

Score a 512GB iPad mini at $449 if you’re quick: That’s $450 off the list price

This deal might sell out quick folks. With the price increases and lack of straight up cash deals on iPad lately, this Amazon Renewed Premium offer on the latest 512GB iPad mini at $449 might be the best offer we have tracked on Apple tablets in months – it is $450 off the new list price.

Amazon is now offering the 512GB iPad mini down at $449 shipped in the gray colorway – we suspect, much like last go around, this deal will not last for long.

If you head over to Amazon right now, you’ll notice the iPad mini starts at $569 in new condition (down from the $599 list price) and that’s for the 128GB model. The 256GB starts at $674, and the 512GB carries an $899 list price.

You’re scoring the 512GB model for less than the price of the entry 128GB here and $450 off the list price on the 512GB – this is a seriously notable offer in the best quality Amazon renewed condition there is:

It comes with a 90% battery life guarantee and a 365-day return period too:

  • Screen: When present, no scratches.
  • Body: No signs of cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, and other) are visible when the product is held 12 inches away.
  • Battery: When included, batteries have a capacity that exceeds 90% of the original battery life.
  • Accessories: Generic or original equipment manufacturer accessories and packaging provided.
  • Guarantee: Renewed Premium items come with a 365-day return period.

Apple’s official Bumper case drops to rock-bottom all-time low at under $13 (68% off)

Anker’s MagSafe Nano Power Bank is one of the best, drops to one of the lowest prices of the year at $49 (All colors)

Anker’s latest Nano Power Bank is easily among the most compelling options out there when it comes to price and form-factor for those just looking for quick top ups on the go. Regularly $60 these days, you can now land one down at $49.50, or within $5 or so of the lowest price ever.

The official Amazon Anker store is now offering its Nano MagSafe Power Bank down at $49.49 shipped.

This is an Amazon Lightning deal and select colors are also close to 50% sold out at the discounted rate.

Now carrying a $60 list price after launching at $55, this is nearly 20% off and the lowest price we can find. While it might not seem like a giant deal, this has been a relatively popular model and it is now within roughly $5 of the Prime Day 2026 all-time low.

This model has a few things going for it. You’re not looking at one of those chunky 10K mAh models here, but rather a more sleek and transportable option for quick top ups while away from an outlet. It also comes in six different colors, from vibrant orange and black, through to softer blues, whites, and even a light gold colorway.

The Qi2-certified is regularly found on best of lists as an alternative to Apple’s iPhone Air Battery, but it can be used on all of the latest latest and previous-generation phones with magnetic and Qi2 action.

Anker’s 26,250mAh Smart Display Power Bank w/ charging base is up to $110 off today

Amazon is still offering AirPods Pro 3 at nearly $50 off right now

Deal pricing at most retailers on the latest and greatest AirPods Pro 3 has gone up now, but you can still land a set at $50 off via Amazon right now.

Amazon is currently offering Apple’s flagship buds down at $199.99 shipped to deliver the lowest price around in brand new condition.

We did just recently get a shot to score them for $10 less there, but if you didn’t get a chance to pull the trigger and are still looking to land a set, there is still some savings up for grabs.

All things considered, save for the Prime Day offer and two other chances, today’s price is on par with the lowest we have tracked since release in September.

It is also worth pointing out that at this point it does not look like a new set of AirPods Pro 4 are landing next month. Most projections, analysts, and rumors have Apple releasing new base model AirPods 5 and not a new pro set this year, so the current AirPods Pro 3 will remain a current-generation investment into 2027. And with rumors of camera tech landing on the next-gen set, there’s no telling how much they will release at.

Ring’s latest Retinal 2K Doorbell now on sale for $50, 4K model $50 off, more

As part of Amazon’s late summer sale, we are tracking some Ring deals and if you don’t need the 4K video action, the latest Ring Wired Doorbell 2K is a significantly less pricey option you can score down at $50 right now.

Amazon is now offering the latest Ring Wired Doorbell Retinal 2K down at $49.99 shipped.

Regularly $80, this is nearly 40% off the list price and within just $10 of the best deal we have ever tracked – it dropped to $40 once since release during the June Prime event.

This might very well be more than enough for most folks with its Retinal 2K video, up to 6x Enhanced Zoom, the ability to “see, hear, and speak in real time with Live View and Two-Way Talk,” and real-time notifications on your phone when motion is detected. But if you’re looking to take it up a notch with 4K action, we are still tracking a price drop on the 4K Pro model:

  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $200 (Reg. $250)

These units feature up to 10x Enhanced Zoom, night vision, and Retinal 4K with wide-angle video alongside a Quick Release Ultra Battery Pack for re-charging on he wireless battery model.
